lines.say: A company bought your city’s weather. Sunny days cost extra.
The app has a menu. Light rain, free. Sun for one day, five hundred dollars.
Saturday is your wedding. You pay for sun.
Saturday morning. It pours. The guests run. The cake melts.
You check the app. Your neighbour paid five hundred and one. For rain. On your day.
Would you pay for sun on your wedding day? Write it in the comments.
